scope: Post-audit development comparison on the same reviewed endpoints within each sampling set. Sources and sampling sets remain separate. OSNet is limited to source 600–720 seconds; only five BoT-SORT-selected references fall in that range. The other 77 are out of scope.
limitations: Assistant review, not independent human ground truth. The 82 BoT-SORT and 34 SAM2 positive hypotheses have different selection distributions; their aggregate precision is not a fair algorithm comparison. Unknown identities do not enter accuracy. Missing observations are separate from rejected matches. The long SAM2 run only covers 600–720 source seconds. Pair decisions do not establish identity throughout the intervening video or full-game statistics.
